top20_quotes.text: The language/wording is off. incorrect words are used or words are misplaced, it's off putting. I also did not find the voices for the meditations or other features soothing at all. The recordings were sort of interesting, but it mostly just alerts to the a/c turning on and light movement. I also didn't like that you don't get a report until after 7 days, but the trial has to be canceled within 7 days. I think if you sleep alone and don't use any white or ambient noise, the app would be okay.

gosh, definitely canceling my subscription!, it's tracker shows the exact same results everynight records everything but my sleeping habits, a whole movie was recorded and my TV is on the lowest volume at night, then everynight I'm resetting preferences times alarms,to pay $60 a year this was a waste of money, I'm definitely contacting Google for refund, when I read numerous reviews with the same issues & shuteye app responders are telling unhappy people to contact Google for a refund,smh😞

Fake - I used the free version of this app whilst waiting for the developers to resolve the failed activation of the trial. The app is straightforward, and appears to record your sleeping environment. In the free version, the detail of the recorded events is locked, unless a premium subscription is paid. However, on review, it is clear that these recordings are bait to intrigue you enough into paying; they're not real. Comparing the recording times and events with real life shows discrepancies.

Incredibly inaccurate reporting. I used this on the free 7 day trial and knew within 3 sessions that I would be cancelling. It was reporting only 3 or 4 hours of sleep each night, with long periods of "awake time". For most of these I was happily asleep. The reported time before going to sleep was wildly inaccurate as well. Cancelled.

It seems like a good app but the reality is that I'm pretty sure that the stats they give for sleeping are very inaccurate and make no sense at all...for example, the last 2 nights I've used the app and it said I slept 32 & 38 mins without any deep sleep...I however woke up feeling like I had plenty of deep sleep and felt energized...plus, it says that I didn't fall asleep until after like 3 hours and 52 minutes...umm sorry but I was exhausted and fell right asleep easily! This is a trash app!

tell me how to cancel my subscription!! the number does not work and I'm sick to death of yall trying to take money off my card!! I don't have the app nor the watch. I want this to stop and stop NOW!!!

I paid for a year and the app seemed to work fine for several months, but stopped working/recording my sleep all of a sudden. I contacted technical support and they could not fix it. I requested a refund, but they said I have to ask through Google Play, but I cannot do it there. So basically, I've paid a year for something I'm unable to use because it does not work any longer.

1 Star (Would give 0 if I could) I started the 7-day free trial and cancelled after just 3 days, well within the trial period — yet this company still took £30.70 from my bank account! To make it worse, the app was never even activated or usable. Google Pay couldn’t trace the transaction either, so I’ve essentially lost my money. Absolutely shocking! Feels like a scam. Avoid at all costs.

If I could give a lower star rating I would. Signed up for the free trial, & agreed to pay the discounted price. The app said I had access to all premium features. Set it up to run the first night, and it did absolutely nothing. It told me to swipe up under my journal, but I couldn't. And yes I was logged in. App did nothing wouldn't give access to premium features, but I refused to track. App is totally worthless. I cancelled immediately via Google Pay.

This app was supposed to start with a 7 day free trial, but it immediately charged me for 12 months of service. Additionally, it did not work as advertised. After 2 hours of laying in bed, fully awake, it was telling me that I had 2 episodes of deep sleep. I had never fallen asleep, so how can that tracking be accurate.

I was charged for a premium subscription a day before the trial period ended. I disputed the charge and the producers of the app said I'm responsible for the charges anyway. Not cool. Especially since in the Google Play store it says the subscription is canceled so now I'm still out the money but ALSO can't access the app that I'm being forced to pay $65 for. Completely ridiculous. And it's not a very good app anyway.

I was charged during the free trial. the app itself is fine, although any time you turn off the tracker, it goes through all the steps to start again. It's redundant. I'm looking to get a refund because I used it for the trial and literally within 24 hours canceled the trial, but they charged me anyway.

The app does not work well. It frequently shuts off during the night. It cannot distinguish between talking coughing snoring whatever. Also, the functionality is creaky. I have to quit it again just to get out of the journal function for some reason. I wish I had not paid for it. After another month of frustration with this app, I'm going to delete it. It's a waste of money. It's too easy for the app to turn itself off, which it does almost every other night.

Terrible. Tried to get a refund. no go. I sleep through the night, but the app records me being "awake" most of the night. I tested this with another app and the other more accurately records my sleep. Also, doesn't work as advertised. Scam. Don't install. [edit] Yes. Unfortunately, it was too late to receive a refund.

App is not useful. Sleep logs are inaccurate and label nighttime activities incorrectly. Additionally, I attempted to contact the company multiple times to request a refund 2 days after being auto-charged. I received a prompt response initially (though it may have been automated). However, then the company repeatedly told me that my Google Play transaction ID was wrong and ignored all my further attempts to respond to their emails with screenshots of the Google Play transaction.

Hello, when I first got the app during the trial, I contacted about how the app did not work. However, I was charged and tried to continue to use it. Each time I use the app, it calculates my sleep, snore rime, etc. All of a sudden, the data changes as if the original correct data never happened. Disappears & gives a new shorter time of sleep, erases the snore time & sound & all othe categories as 0min. The app does not work correctly. It is a problem for ill patients trying to get help w insomn

It's the worst app ever. DO NOT INSTALL. The app was recording my sleep during the free trial. The app saved my recordings for few nights but not after. It literally does not save if you want to listen to your recording and other noises after. In addition, you need to select each recording category each night before tracking. Why can't I save my preferences. We need convenience. I am not going to kill my phone battery all night for nothing if the app is not going recordings. Please REFUND

First, you have to pay for it. Which wouldn't be so bad, if the app was accurate. What I mean is when it records sounds, it can't tell the difference of a bed creaking from footsteps, flatulence, snoring, talking, or teeth grinding. It can't tell the difference between talking and getting a notification from your phone. Also instead of playing sounds for sleep constantly throughout the night to help you sleep, it'll automatically shut-off. Take your hard earned money elsewhere and avoid this app

After sending numerous tickets, and received no response on technical issues, like recording did not work and received inaccurate data, I requested a refund. The developer pointed out to Google Play. After containing them, they told me to request a refund from the developer. Absolutely useless! I want my money back! I contacted them for a resolution but they failed answering and now I passed the time frame given.

Signed up for this app due to it having a 7-day trial period so I could see if I liked it. Downloaded it, created an account, and the next day was charged full price for a membership, no free trial allowed. Faulty advertisement and now I've paid for an app I dont want to use because it's scamy to advertise a trial but take the money anyways. Will look for a different app
